name: Shota Sleepover Stories
source:
You'll play as Jason with his best friend Rubin. Jason is going to share all sorts of wonderful stories about how he and Rubin seduced all their friends!

[From [url=https://shotaworld.com/threads/shota-sleepover-stories-v0-14-released-03-01-22.2669/]Shotaworld[/url]]
translation:
你將扮演傑森，與他最好的朋友魯賓相伴。傑森有一肚子有趣的故事要講，說的都是他和魯賓如何把身邊的朋友一一勾引到手！

[摘自[url=https://shotaworld.com/threads/shota-sleepover-stories-v0-14-released-03-01-22.2669/]Shotaworld[/url]]
